blocks.text: CEBU CITY — The Cebu provincial government suspended classes at all levels in public and private schools across the province starting at noon on Monday to mark National Teachers’ Day and World Teachers’ Day. Gov. Pamela S. Baricuatro signed Executive Order No. 54, Series of 2026, ordering the provincewide suspension. The order allows classes scheduled before noon to proceed, subject to individual schools’ and education authorities’ policies and discretion.
